# Banna Restaurant & Bar

> Banna Restaurant & Bar is an Eritrean and Ethiopian restaurant at 9560 Skillman St #120, Dallas, TX 75243. Open daily 11am–2am. Phone (214) 758-0752. Dine-in, takeout, delivery and catering. Most main dishes are $17–$29; sharing combo platters are $24–$28.

## What we serve
Injera platters, tibs (Awaze Lamb Tibs, Shekla Beef Tibs, Chicken Tibs), wats (Doro Wat, Key Wat, Shiro, Miser), vegan and fasting dishes (Beyaynetu, Veggie Special Combo), breakfast, sides, Eritrean beer, Tej honey wine and traditional Ethiopian coffee. Vegan platters are served every day of the year, not only during Tsom.

## Ordering
Order online at https://banna-restaurant.cloveronline.com/menu/all, or through Uber Eats and DoorDash. Takeout orders are typically ready in 15–25 minutes. Call (214) 758-0752 for catering and large trays.

## Facts
- Cuisine: Eritrean, Ethiopian
- Address: 9560 Skillman St #120, Dallas, TX 75243
- Phone: (214) 758-0752

- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 11:00–02:00
- Parking: free lot on site
- Vegan options: yes, year-round
- Reservations: walk-ins welcome; recommended at peak hours
